content: Swift->Kotlin numeric port: Swift sort is Timsort-stable (undocumented guarantee) and Kotlin sortedBy is documented-stable; danger is primitive DoubleArray.sort() (dual-pivot quicksort, unstable) and NaN: Swift < leaves NaN unordered (strict-weak-ordering violation), Java Double.compare totally orders NaN greater than +Inf and -0.0<0.0; Kotlin data-class equals uses Double.equals semantics (NaN==NaN true, 0.0!=-0.0) while Swift == is IEEE; rounding defaults differ (Swift rounded()=half-away-from-zero; JVM Math.round=half-up; Math.rint=half-even); day-boundary math must use java.time LocalDate/atStartOfDay(zone) which handles DST-skipped midnights, never epochMillis/86400000.
